mechanism: Rifampin induces CYP24A1 and CYP3A4, increasing metabolism and clearance of the active form of cholecalciferol (calcitriol), reducing vitamin D bioavailability and efficacy.
action: Monitor serum calcium, phosphate, and alkaline phosphatase levels; consider increasing cholecalciferol dose or using calcitriol; monitor for signs of vitamin D deficiency during rifampin co-therapy.
